description: Partial undergraduate funding for North Carolina residents (and residents of listed upstate South Carolina counties).
eligibility_text: Enrolled or planning to enroll full-time at a two- or four-year not-for-profit U.S. college; legal resident of North Carolina or of York, Cherokee, Spartanburg, Greenville, Laurens, Lancaster, Kershaw, Union, Chester, Chesterfield, Fairfield or Darlington County, SC; GPA 2.5 or higher; no felony drug conviction.
